verdict.rationale: Stripe Identity exposes verification results programmatically via the VerificationSession API, webhooks that fire on status changes, and endpoints to retrieve extracted document data and verification details, which gives an automated flow machine-readable outcomes to branch on (docs-6, docs-7, docs-13, docs-15, docs-16). However, the evidence doesn't document explicit structured risk-score/signal fields or a taxonomy of failure-reason codes beyond generic status ('verified'/'requires_input'), and real-world reports show ambiguous rejection reasons for certain document types (comm-12, comm-13) that would complicate automated branching logic. Missing for 10: documented risk-signal/score schema, enumerated machine-readable failure-reason codes, and independent confirmation that agents can reliably branch on nuanced outcomes.
